subdomains: DevOps CI/CD Pipelines & Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Ansible)

schema.messages: array of objects containing role ('system', 'user', 'assistant') and content (string)
schema.target_commands: array of strings (verified executable CLI commands or configurations)
schema.root_cause_category: string (e.g., Configuration Error, Resource Exhaustion, Permission Denial, Network Timeout)

licensing: Research and Academic Use Only (Synthetic and Sanitized Enterprise Postmortem Logs)

anonymization.usernames: Normalized to standard service accounts (e.g., devops-admin, app-svc)
anonymization.api_keys: Scrubbed with SHA-256 entropy filters and replaced with <SECRET_REDACTED>
